newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian stocks gain amid fresh investor interest.
newsitem.headline: Estonian stocks gain amid fresh investor interest.

text.p: Trade on the Estonian bourse was stronger again on Thursday and dealers said investor appetite had been refreshed due to a belief prices cannot fall further.
Total trade on the main list was 46.2 million kroons with the Talse 0.69 percent stronger at 250.83.
"I would not say the mood on the bourse has changed but investors do not think prices will fall much further so there is more buying interest," one trader said.
"But the gains from today could all go away tomorrow so this is not a firm trend yet," he added.
Leading bank Hansapank turned over 10.5 million kroons to end on 128.50 kroons, up 0.85 kroons.
Forekspank was also well traded at 9.7 million kroons to gain one kroons to close at 175 kroons.
The free market turned over 4.7 million kroons with most stocks easing or stable.
Kalev was the most active to drop 25 kroons to close at 1,705 kroons after trade of 1.7 million kroons.
